notes: Harvested via logged-in Chrome reading each post's embedded page JSON (Instagram's /api/v1 was hard rate-limited, so per-post navigation was used instead of the grid API). postCount is the distinct items enumerated: 53 static flyer posts (photo/carousel) plus 7 reels. Instagram's profile header showed 59 posts; the 60-vs-59 difference is an IG count discrepancy, not a dropped post. The 7 reels are recorded as failures because they are videos whose covers are low-res vertical stills, not flyers; their shortcodes are listed so the build session can revisit them. Image w/h are the real decoded dimensions. Each image is the max-resolution image_versions2 candidate served on the post page. 2026-10-21: added Dep8RVAjbrQ (Whistler, Nov 1 2026, posted 2026-10-18, collab with @mark_cabinian), read logged-out from the post page JSON; largest served candidate per slide, so the flyer is 1080x1440 (Instagram serves nothing larger for it). altText is the per-slide IG auto alt (slide 1 here; slides 2 to 4 differ). Photo tags: slide 1 @whistlerchicago @mark_cabinian, slide 2 @mark_cabinian, slide 3 @thy_niconico, slide 4 @luisvercetti. postCount raised 60 to 61.
